scybala.definition: n. pl. Hardened masses of feces.

scye.definition:
n. Arm scye, a cutter's term for the armhole or part of the
   armhole of the waist of a garnment.

scyliorhinidae.translation: [网络] 猫鲨科；猫鲛科；二名法

scylla.definition: n. (Greek mythology) a sea nymph transformed into a sea monster who lived on one side of a narrow strait; drowned and devoured sailors who tried to escape Charybdis (a whirlpool) on the other side of the strait
scylla.translation: n. 锡拉岩礁（靠近意大利一边的危险岩石）

scyllarian.definition:
n. One of a family (Scyllaridae) of macruran Crustacea,
   remarkable for the depressed form of the body, and the broad, flat
   antennae. Also used adjectively.

scyllite.definition:
n. A white crystalline substance of a sweetish taste,
   resembling inosite and metameric with dextrose. It is extracted from
   the kidney of the dogfish (of the genus Scylium), the shark, and the
   skate.

scyllitol.translation: 鲨[异]肌醇, 青蟹肌醇

scymnol.translation:
[化] 鲨胆甾醇
[医] 鲨胆甾醇, 鲨胆固醇

scyphi.definition: n an ancient Greek drinking cup; two handles and footed base

scyphistoma.definition:
n. The young attached larva of Discophora in the stage
   when it resembles a hydroid, or actinian.
scyphistoma.translation: n. [动]螅状幼体,钵口幼虫(亦作scyphistome)

scyphozoa.definition:
n coelenterates in which the polyp stage is absent or at least inconspicuous: jellyfishes
n any of various usually free-swimming marine coelenterates having a gelatinous medusoid stage as the dominant phase of its life cycle

scyphozoan.definition: n any of various usually free-swimming marine coelenterates having a gelatinous medusoid stage as the dominant phase of its life cycle

scyphozoans.definition:
plural of scyphozoan
n any of various usually free-swimming marine coelenterates having a gelatinous medusoid stage as the dominant phase of its life cycle

scyphus.definition: n an ancient Greek drinking cup; two handles and footed base

scyra.translation: [法] 郡, 郡民, 郡的居民

scythe.definition:
n. an edge tool for cutting grass; has a long handle that must be held with both hands and a curved blade that moves parallel to the ground
v. cut with a scythe
scythe.translation:
n. 长柄大镰刀, 大钐镰
vt. 用大镰刀割

scythed.definition: a. Armed scythes, as a chariot.
scythed.translation: v. （长柄）大镰刀( scythe的过去式和过去分词 )

scytheman.definition: n. One who uses a scythe; a mower.
scytheman.translation: n. 使用长柄大镰刀者

scythes.definition:
n an edge tool for cutting grass; has a long handle that must be held with both hands and a curved blade that moves parallel to the ground
v cut with a scythe
scythes.translation:
n. （长柄）大镰刀( scythe的名词复数 )
v. （长柄）大镰刀( scythe的第三人称单数 )

scythestone.definition: n. A stone for sharpening scythes; a whetstone.

scythia.definition: n an ancient area of Eurasia extending from the Black Sea to the Aral Sea that was populated by Scythians from the eighth to the fourth century BC
scythia.translation: 锡西厄(古代欧洲东南部以黑海北岸为中心的一地区)

scythian.definition:
n. a member of the ancient nomadic people inhabiting Scythia
n. the Iranian language spoken by the ancient Scythians
a. of or relating to the ancient Scythians or their culture or language
scythian.translation:
n. 斯基台人[语]
a. 斯基台的, 斯基台人[语]的

scythians.definition:
plural of Scythian
n. a member of the ancient nomadic people inhabiting Scythia
n. the Iranian language spoken by the ancient Scythians
a. of or relating to the ancient Scythians or their culture or language
scythians.translation:
(Scythian 的复数) n.斯基台人[语]
a. 斯基台的, 斯基台人[语]的

scything.translation: v. （长柄）大镰刀( scythe的现在分词 )
